about: The statement an executor leaves: one JSON object. Every field is required and no other field is allowed. A field has a kind: word (text that is one of the listed words), text (text that is not blank), list (a list whose every item has the item kind; it may be empty), object (an object with exactly the listed fields). The same schema is the shape of a builder's hand-off.

fields.name: claim
fields.about: What the executor says about the work: done, partly_done, blocked or not_done.

fields.name: summary
fields.about: What was done or found, in a few sentences.

fields.name: evidence
claim
fields.about: One thing the executor says is true.

fields.name: command
fields.about: A command that shows it, to run again; not a pasted log.
What shows the claim is true, each as a claim and a command to run.

fields.name: not_tested
fields.about: What the executor did not test, one thing per item; empty when nothing was left out.

fields.name: feedback
fields.about: Feedback on the input (the instruction and the references); say so when there is none.
